notes: Dashboard 2.0 (@flowfuse/node-red-dashboard, /dashboard): ui nodes are ui-page/ui-group/ui-text/ui-button/ui-notification. Fix vs v2.0.0: the flow no longer ships its own ui-base/ui-theme (two tab files would put two ui-base nodes on /dashboard, which breaks widget wiring) — assign the page + notification to your single ui-base in the editor sidebar. Requires @flowfuse/node-red-dashboard installed. Logic unchanged from v1.3.0.
